title: Past Perfect / Pluscuamperfecto (mbala oyo pasi na mbala mosusu oyo pasi)
bridge: Na español, pluscuamperfecto (había comido) ekomisa mbala mosusu oyo pasi na ntango mosusu oyo pasi. Na anglais, past perfect (had eaten) ezali na motuya moko, kasi kuna makomami oyo ya ntina: lisolo ya bato ezali moke (na anglais kaka 'had + participio'), mpe na anglais ezali kokamwisa na 'already', 'just', 'never' mpo na kopesa ntina na lisolo. Boye: na español mbala mosusu tokosala na pretérito indefinido (comí) kasi na anglais ezali na mfuna past perfect (had eaten) soki kuna mbala mosusu oyo pasi oyo ntina. Mpe na español, pluscuamperfecto ekomisa na verbe 'haber' oyo ekonzami, kasi na anglais 'had' ezali ya moko na bato nionso.
rule: Past perfect ekomisa na 'had' (na bato nionso) + participio oyo pasi ya verbe ya ntina. Ezali kosalema mpo na kopesa ntina na mbala mosusu oyo pasi, ya só, 'mbala oyo pasi na mbala mosusu oyo pasi'. Na masolo oyo malamu: moto + had + participio. Na masolo oyo mabe: had not (hadn't) + participio. Na botungi: Had + moto + participio. Ezali kosalema na makomami oyo ya ntina lokola 'already', 'just', 'never', 'ever', 'by the time', 'before', 'after'. Yangó: 'I had finished my homework before dinner' (nazali komema lisolo na ntango ya mangembo). Mpe ezali kosalema na discours indirect mpo na kobimisa ntango ya verbe (present perfect -> past perfect). Makomami: na anglais na 'after' mpe 'before' mbala mosusu tokosala na passé simple soki lisolo ezali ya ntina, kasi past perfect ekopesa ntina mingi. Boye: na español pluscuamperfecto ezali kosalema na ntango oyo ya ntina; na anglais ezali ya ntina na masolo mpo na kopesa ntina na lisolo ya makambo.

common_error.wrong: When I arrived, she already left.
common_error.correct: When I arrived, she had already left.
common_error.correct_alt: She had already left when I arrived.
common_error.explanation: Na español, ezali ya sika kosala na pretérito indefinido (ye sukoli) mpo na mbala oyo pasi, kasi na anglais, mpo na kopesa ntina ete mbala mosusu sukoli liboso na mbala mosusu oyo pasi, ezali na mfuna past perfect (had + participio). Lisalisi ezali na contexte: mbala ya 'kosukola' sukoli liboso ya 'koka', mpo na yango tokosala 'had left'. Mpo na kozongela yango, tina mbala oyo pasi liboso mpe sala yango na past perfect; mbala oyo pasi oyo sukoli na passé simple.

examples.original: I had finished my work.

title: Conditionals Type 1 and 2 / Kondisyonel tip 1 na 2
bridge: Na español, tosilaka verbu ya présent na subjonctif na klaúza ya kondisyonel mpe verbu ya kondisyonel simple na klaúza ya mboyo (Si tengo tiempo, iría). Na anglais, esika ekomi moke: na kondisyonel ya liboso tosilaka verbu ya présent simple na klaúza ya 'if' mpe verbu ya futur na 'will' na klaúza ya mboyo. Na kondisyonel ya zomi, tosilaka verbu ya passé simple na klaúza ya 'if' mpe 'would' + infinitif na klaúza ya mboyo. Koyeba: na anglais, verbu ya passé simple na kondisyonel ya zomi ekomisa ntango ya passé te, kasi mposa ya kondisyonel to mposa ya kozala te na présent to na futur. Kobima yango te koyekola na mot na mot na español, kasi esika ekomi moke.
rule: Kondisyonel ya liboso (tip 1) esalemi na mposa ya kozala na présent to na futur. Esalemi na: If + sujet + verbu na présent simple, + sujet + will + verbu ya mboyo. Molakisi: If it rains, we will stay at home. Klaúza ya 'if' ekoki kozala na liboso to na zomi, mpe soki ekomi na liboso, esepeli na virgule. Ekoki mpe kosalema 'unless' (soki te) na esika ya 'if not'. Kondisyonel ya zomi (tip 2) esalemi na mposa ya kondisyonel, mposa ya kozala te to mposa ya kozala te na présent to na futur. Esalemi na: If + sujet + verbu na passé simple, + sujet + would + verbu ya mboyo. Molakisi: If I had more money, I would travel. Na kondisyonel ya zomi, verbu 'to be' esalemi na 'were' na bato nyonso (If I were...). 'Was' esalemi te na esika ya formel, kasi na anglais ya moke, esalemi yango mbala. Ekoki mpe kosalema 'could' to 'might' na esika ya 'would' mpo na koyeba mposa to makasi.

title: Passive Voice: Present & Past / Mbotó ya pasi: likambo ya luntante na ya libwa
bridge: Na espanyolí, mbotó ya pasi ezalaka na 'ser' + participio, kaka oyo ezali na nguma (to be + past participle). Kasi, na nguma, motó moko oyo akosala bosungi akomataka na 'by', lokola na espanyolí tozali kosalaka 'por'. Kasi, na nguma, motó moko oyo akosala bosungi akomataka mingi koleka na espanyolí, wapi tozali kopesa likolo ya kobomba mbotó ya aktívó to ya pasívó ya kopesa ('se'). Nsango moko oyo ezali na ntina ezali kobenga verba 'to be' to kopesa ntina na forme ya participio ya libwa.
rule: Mbotó ya pasi ezalaka na verba 'to be' na ntango nyonso (likambo ya luntante: am/is/are; likambo ya libwa: was/were) + participio ya libwa ya verba ya ntina. Motó moko oyo akosala bosungi na mbotó ya aktívó akomataka na 'by' (ata soki ezali na ntina te, ezali na bosongi). Po na kosala mbotó ya pasi, motó moko oyo akosala bosungi na mbotó ya aktívó akomataka na motó moko oyo akosala bosungi. Mibongo: Aktívó: 'The chef cooks the meal' → Pasívó: 'The meal is cooked by the chef'. Na likambo ya luntante, tozali kosalaka 'is/are' na ntango nyonso (ya motó moko to ya mibali). Na likambo ya libwa, 'was/were'. Participio ya libwa ezali forme ya verba ya ntina (ya ntango nyonso: -ed; ya libwa: lisiti). Makasi: mbotó ya pasi ezali te na verba ya kozala na motó moko oyo akosala bosungi (ezali te na motó moko oyo akosala bosungi). Bosaleli ya ntina: soki motó moko oyo akosala bosungi azali te na ntina, to soki azali na ntina te, to soki azali na ntina te.

title: Reported Speech / Mokolo ya mibeko ya ndakisa
bridge: Na español, mpo na kopesa ndakisa ya mibeko, tozali kobimisa mikolo ya mibeko (na ndakisa, 'dijo que tenía hambre'), mpe na anglais ezali mawa, kasi na biloko mosusu oyo ezali kobimisa: bango, mpe lokota ya mbula mpe ya lelo (today→that day, here→there) mpe kosala lisolo ya mazo. Nsango moko oyo ezali kozala na ntina ezali kobenga mokolo ya mibeko ya ndakisa (dijo: 'I am tired' → *She said she is tired), kasi na anglais B1 tolingi 'backshift': 'She said she was tired'. Bosembo moko mosusu ezali ete na anglais tokoki kozwa 'that' te (tokoki koloba 'She said she was tired' to 'She said that she was tired'), kasi na español 'que' ezali na ntina.
rule: Mokolo ya mibeko ya ndakisa ezali kozwa mibeko ya moto moko. Na anglais, mpe mibeko ya ndakisa ezali kozwa 'say' to 'tell'. 'Say' ezali na bango ya moto te (He said he was happy), kasi 'tell' ezali na bango (He told me he was happy). Mibeko ya ndakisa ya mibeko: 1) Mikolo ya mibeko (presente→pasado, pasado→pluscuamperfecto): 'I am' → 'she was', 'I went' → 'she had gone'. 2) Bango: 'I' → 'he/she', 'my' → 'his/her'. 3) Lokota ya mbula: 'today'→'that day', 'tomorrow'→'the next day', 'yesterday'→'the day before'. 4) Lokota ya lelo: 'here'→'there'. Mibeko ya ndakisa: soki mibeko ezali na ntina to mbula ezwami, tokoki kobenga mokolo ya ndakisa (She said she is tired - soki azali na ntina). Mpo na biloko, tozali kozwa 'if' to 'whether' mpo na biloko ya ndenge, mpe mpe mibeko ya biloko ya ndakisa, na lisolo ya mibeko (He asked me where I lived, te 'where did I live'). Mpo na mibeko ya kosala, tozali kozwa 'tell/ask + moto + to + infinitivo' (He told me to sit down).

title: Gerunds and Infinitives as Subject and Object / Baninga na mabotami koti sujet na objet
bridge: Na espanyolé, tozali kozonga mabotami koti sujet mpe na nsima ya bankobo mingi (lokola, 'kozwa ezali mbote', 'nalingi kozwa'). Kasi na anglais, likambo ezali moke: mokolo moke tozali kozonga baninga (-ing) mpe mokolo moke mabotami (to + verbe). Regle ya ndenge nionso ezali ete soki bobomi ezali sujet ya lokuta, tozali kozonga baninga. Na bankobo mosusu lokola 'enjoy' to 'finish', tozali kozonga baninga. Na bankobo mosusu lokola 'want' to 'decide', tozali kozonga mabotami. Likambo oyo ezali mbongo mpenza koti ya bato ya espanyolé mpo ezali na likambo oyo ezali ya ndenge nionso te.
rule: Na anglais, ezali na baninga mibali ya verbe: baninga (verb + -ing) mpe mabotami (to + base form). Koti sujet ya lokuta, baninga ezali ndenge ya kobombama mpe ya solo (lokola, 'Kozwa ezali sante'). Koti objet, kozonga ezali na kozonga ya verbe ya ndenge nionso: bankobo mosusu kozali kozonga na baninga (enjoy, finish, avoid, suggest, consider), bankobo mosusu kozali kozonga na mabotami (want, need, decide, hope, plan). Bankobo mosusu kozali kobenga na ndenge ya kozonga (lokola 'stop' to 'remember'). Koti ya bato ya B1, ezali mbote ya kozwa lisiti ya bankobo mingi mpe ya kosala na mikanda.

title: Modal Verbs for Deduction / Baninga ya modal po na kosila (must, might, could)
bridge: Na lingála, tozali kosalela 'ezali' to 'ezali na' po na kosila oyo ezalaka na makasi ya solo, 'ebimisaki' po na biso oyo bazali na makasi ya kati, mpe 'ekoki' po na oyo ezali na makasi ya moke. Kasi, na anglais ezali mboté ya moko: banga ya modal ezalaka na lokuta moko mpe ezali na 'to' na ntina. Mboté moko ezalaka ete na lingála tozali kosalela bosolo ('ezali') po na kosila, kasi na anglais tozali kosalela 'must' + motuna ya bosolo. Oyo ekoki kolinga yo soki oyekola na ndenge ya lokuta. Boye, na anglais, kosila ekomama na modal + motuna ya bosolo, na 'to', mpe bosolo ya lokola ezali: moto + modal + motuna.
rule:
Na anglais, po na kosila ya bosolo tozali kosalela 'must', 'might' mpe 'could'. 
- **Must** + motuna ya bosolo: ekoma kosila na makasi ya solo (bosolo, boyokani ya makasi). Ekokani na 'ezali' na lingála. Mf: 'She must be at home' (Azali na ndako). 
- **Might** + motuna ya bosolo: ekoma makasi ya kati, boyokani. Ekokani na 'ebimisaki' to 'mbala'. Mf: 'He might be sick' (Ebimisaki azali na koki). 
- **Could** + motuna ya bosolo: ekomaka makasi, kasi mbala moko tozali kosalela po na kosala ete oyo ekoki kozala, kasi ezali na makasi ya moke. Ekokani na 'ekoki'. Mf: 'It could rain today' (Ekoki kosala liboso). 

**Bango:** banga ya modal ezalaka na lokuta moko (ezali na '-s' na ntina ya yande/yande/yande). Ezali na 'to' na ntina. Bosungi ya 'must' po na kosila ezali 'can't' (te 'mustn't'): 'She can't be at work' (Azali te na mosala). 

**Bosaleli:** tozali kosalela po na kozwa bosolo ya kosila na bosolo. Po na kosila ya liboso, tozali kosalela 'must have + motuna', 'might have + motuna', etc., kasi oyo ezali ya moke po na B1. 

**Boyokani:** tozali kosalela te 'must' po na nokingi ya kosila; kasi tozali kosalela 'Do you think...' to bosolo ya nokingi na 'be' to bango ya moko.

title: Relative Clauses: Defining vs. Non-Defining / Bandámsi ya molóngani: oyo ezali kosala ekomi ná oyo ezali kosala ekomi te
bridge: Na espanyolé, bandámsí ya molóngani oyo ezali kosala ekomi ná oyo ezali kosala ekomi te ezali kobundisama na likama: oyo ezali kosala ekomi te ezali na likama. Na anglais, kati na likama, motuna ya molóngani ezali kokoma: 'that' ezali kosalema na bango oyo ezali kosala ekomi (ná esengeli kobimisa yango), mpe 'which/who' na bango oyo ezali kosala ekomi te ezali kosalema na likama. Boye: na anglais, oyo ezali kosala ekomi te ta esengeli kosalema na 'that'.
rule: Bandámsí ya molóngani oyo ezali kosala ekomi (ezali kobundisa motuna to ngunguata oyo toli yango) ezali na likama te mpe esengeli kosalema na 'that' to 'who/which'. Na ndakisa ya malamu, 'that' (to motuna ya bosungi) esengeli kobimisama: 'The book (that) I bought'. Oyo ezali kosala ekomi te (ezali kosala ekomi te) ezali na likama mpe ezali kosalema na 'who' na bango ya banutu mpe 'which' na bango ya ngunguata, kasi 'that' te. Motuna ta esengeli kobimisama na bango oyo ezali kosala ekomi te. Ndakisa: Defining: 'The woman who lives next door is a doctor.' (Mwasi oyo azali kopesa lifelo na kotí ezali medecin). Non-defining: 'My sister, who lives in Madrid, is a doctor.' (Mokonzi na ngai, oyo azali kopesa lifelo na Madrid, ezali medecin).

title: Wish + past / Kozwa mpenza oyo ezali te na mbongo
bridge: Na espanyol, tosilanga 'ojalá' to 'me gustaría que' na subjuntivo po kozwa mpenza oyo ezali te na mbongo. Na anglais, 'wish' ekombami na temps passé (simple to parfait) po komonisa ete likambo ezali te na mbongo na présent to ezali te na mbongo na passé. Molongo moko ezali kozwa na présent to conditionnel ('I wish I have...' to 'I wish I would have...'), na ntina ya espanyol. Boya: passé na anglais awa ekomonisi te temps, kasi kozwa oyo ezali te na mbongo.
rule: Structure ya mawa ezali: **wish + sujet + verbe na passé simple** po kozwa oyo ezali te na mbongo na présent (situation oyo ezali te na mbongo to hypothétique). M例: 'I wish I knew the answer' (Nazali koyeba te). Po kozwa oyo ezali te na mbongo na passé (likambo oyo esili kokoma te), tosilanga **wish + passé parfait** ('I wish I had studied more'). Tosilanga te 'would' na nsuka ya 'wish' soki sujet ezali moko (I wish I would... ezali malamu te); tosilanga 'would' kaka po kozwa oyo ezali te na mbongo na comportement ya mosusu (I wish you would stop). Na 'wish' + 'were' ezali fixe na esika ya 'was' (ata 'was' ekoki kozala na anglais ya mawa). Boya ete 'wish' ekomonisa regret to frustration; po kozwa oyo ekoki kozala na mbongo tosilanga 'hope' (I hope you come).

title: Used to / Kozonga makambo oyo ezali ko pasar liboso
bridge: Na español, tozali kozonga makambo oyo ezali ko pasar liboso na 'solía + infinitivo' to 'pretérito imperfecto' (moko 'jugaba'). Na anglais, 'used to' ezali formule fixe oyo ezali na passé mpe ezalaka na forme moko mpo na nionso (I used to, she used to). Erreur ya solo ezali kozonga 'used to' na 'be used to' (kozala kotambola na) to na 'use to' na négation mpe na question. Boya kozonga na négation mpe na question ezali 'didn't use to' mpe 'Did you use to?'.
rule: 'Used to' ezali kozonga makambo oyo ezali ko pasar liboso oyo ezalaka te na présent. Structure na yango ezali: sujet + used to + verbe base. Ezali na passé mpe ezali te na présent to na futur; na présent tozali kozonga 'usually' + présent simple. Mpo na négation: didn't use to + verbe base. Mpo na question: Did + sujet + use to + verbe base? (kozala na -d te). Boya: tozali kozonga te 'I use to' mpo na passé, mpe 'used to' ezali na -ed te na passé mpo ezali déjà passé. Ezali mpe 'would' mpo na makambo oyo ezali ko pasar liboso, kasi mpo na actions mpe te mpo na états.

title: Purpose, Cause and Result / Mokano, Mokolo na Bosembo
bridge: Na espanyol, tozali kosenga 'para que' po mokano mpe 'porque' po mokolo, boye na anglais tozali kosenga 'so that' mpe 'because (of)'. Lisusu, 'so that' tozali koyoka na sima ya mobeko (motuna + bosemi), boye 'because of' tozali koyoka na sima ya nkombo. Na anglais, tozali kosenga 'so' (ntoko 'that') po bosembo, oyo na espanyol ezali 'así que' to 'por lo tanto'.
rule:
Po kozonga mokano, mokolo mpe bosembo na anglais, tozali kosenga mitindo oyo:
- **Mokano:** 'so that' (po nani) + mobeko na bosemi modal (can, could, will, would) to presente simple. Molai: 'I study so that I can pass the exam.' Lisusu, tokoki kosenga 'in order to' (po) + infinitif, kasi ezali ya ntango malamu.
- **Mokolo:** 'because' (na nani) + mobeko, to 'because of' (na nzela ya) + nkombo to groupe ya nkombo. Molai: 'She stayed home because she was sick' (mobeko) vs. 'She stayed home because of the rain' (nkombo).
- **Bosembo:** 'so' (na nzela ya) + mobeko ya bosembo. Molai: 'It was raining, so we stayed home.' Lisusu, tokoki kosenga 'therefore' (na nzela ya) na makambo ya ntango malamu.
- **Kosepela na espanyol:** Na espanyol, 'para que' ezali na nswami ya subjonctif ('para que estudies'), boye na anglais tozali kosenga indicatif (mbala nyingi na 'can' to 'could'). Kotiya te 'so' (bosembo) na 'so that' (mokano).

title: Common Phrasal Verbs / Verbo ya Motuna o Mokolo
bridge: Na español, bankaka ya verbo ekokisa bosungi na nsango moko (koti, 'levantar', 'apagar'), kasi na anglais, phrasal verbs ekombisa verbo na motuna moko (up, down, off, etc.) oyo esala na yango na ntina moko to oyo ekokisa ntina. Koti, 'get up' ezali te 'kobanda kozala na likolo', kasi 'kobukisa'. Bosembo ya mpenza ezali ete bato oyo bazali na ntina ezali kobundana na bango na ntina moko, mpe na phrasal verbs oyo bazali kosala na yango, oyo ekoki kozala na kati ya verbo na motuna ('turn the TV off' to 'turn off the TV'), oyo ezali te na mokano na español.
rule: Phrasal verb ezali kombinasion ya verbo na preposition to adverbe (motuna). Ntina ya kombinasion ezali mpenza te kobundana na bango moke. Kasi, bango boledi na ntina moko. Kuna na mibongo mibale: oyo ekoki kozala na kati ya verbo na motuna mpe oyo ezali te. Na oyo ekoki kozala na kati ya verbo na motuna, oyo ekoki kozala na kati ya verbo na motuna (koti, 'turn the TV off' to 'turn off the TV'), kasi soki oyo ekoki kozala na kati ya verbo na motuna ezali na motuna (it, them, etc.), ezali na bosembo kozala na kati ya verbo na motuna: 'turn it off' (te 'turn off it'). Na oyo ezali te, oyo ekoki kozala na kati ya verbo na motuna ezali na bosembo kozala na nsango ya motuna: 'look after the children' (te 'look children after'). Phrasal verbs mosusu ezali te mpe ezali te na oyo ekoki kozala na kati ya verbo na motuna: 'wake up', 'grow up'. Ezali na bosembo kozala na motuna ya ntina mpe ntina na mokano.

title: Advanced Quantifiers / Baquantifwa ya makasi
bridge: Na español, tosilaka mbongo 'pocos', 'bastantes', 'casi ningún' mpo na kosalela likambo, kasi na anglais ba concepti oyo basili na ba quantifwa mibale na makasi na biloko bosanoli na ezalí kosalema. Likama mpenza ezali ete 'hardly any' na 'plenty of' basili na bangonga ya kopesa na bangonga ya kosalema: 'hardly any' ekombola 'casi' na 'ninguno', mpe 'plenty of' ekomi 'más que suficiente', kasi te 'mucho'. Mpe boye, boyoka ete 'plenty of' ekosalema na ba phrases ya kobebisa, kasi te na ba phrases ya koloba te to ya kopusa, maloba 'much/many'.
rule: Baquantifwa ya makasi na anglais (B1) ezali: 'hardly any' (casi ningún/ninguno) ekosalema na ba noms ya bosanoli na ba pluriel mpe ya ezalí kosalema, mpe ezali na nsango ya malamu (ekomiyela 'very few' to 'very little'). 'Plenty of' (bastante, más que suficiente) ekosalema na ba phrases ya kobebisa na ba noms ya bosanoli na ba pluriel mpe ya ezalí kosalema (kasi te na ba questions na 'any' to na ba negations). Baquantifwa mosusu: 'a good deal of' (bastante, ya makasi, ya ezalí kosalema), 'a large amount of' (una gran cantidad de, ya ezalí kosalema), 'a large number of' (un gran número de, ya bosanoli), 'a couple of' (un par de, ya bosanoli). Boye, 'plenty of' ekomi na ndaku ya nomo to pronom, kasi te na ndaku ya adjectif. 'Hardly any' ekosalema liboso ya nomo mpe mpenza ekosalema na 'there is/are'. Na ba questions mpe ba negations, basili kolinga 'much' to 'many' na esika ya 'plenty'.

title: Verb patterns: verb + infinitive / gerund / Mokili ya mibongo: bongo + infinitif / gerundium
bridge: Na español, sima na bongo moko ya ntama tozali kosalela infinitif (p.e. 'quiero comer', 'evito hablar'). Kasi na anglais, mibongo misusu (lokola 'enjoy', 'avoid', 'finish') bazali kotinda gerundium (-ing), boye mibongo misusu (lokola 'want', 'decide', 'hope') bazali kotinda infinitif na 'to'. Kuna na mibongo oyo bazali kobimisa nzela ya kozala na esika na yango ya kozala na infinitif to gerundium (p.e. 'stop to smoke' vs. 'stop smoking'). Boye ezali mpenza ya solo mpo na kozala na molongo ya kozala na anglais.
rule: Na anglais, mibongo ya ntama bazali kopesa mibongo misusu na nzela mibili: na infinitif oyo ezali na 'to' liboso (I want to go) to na gerundium (-ing) (I enjoy going). Kozala na yango ezali kozala na bongo ya ntama. Lisolo ya malamu: - Mibongo oyo bazali kotinda infinitif: want, need, decide, hope, plan, promise, agree, offer, forget, learn, etc. - Mibongo oyo bazali kotinda gerundium: enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, consider, suggest, practice, admit, deny, etc. - Mibongo oyo bazali kotinda mibili na kozala na esika na yango ya kozala na nzela moko: start, begin, continue, like, love, hate, prefer. - Mibongo oyo bazali kobimisa nzela ya kozala na esika na yango ya kozala na infinitif to gerundium: remember, forget, stop, try, regret. (P.e. 'Remember to lock the door' = kokumbwa yango oyo ozali na yango; 'Remember locking the door' = kokumbwa yango oyo ozali na yango). Boye: na mibongo ya kozala na esika na yango ya kozala na 'make' na 'let', tozali kosalela infinitif na 'to' (I saw him leave, They made me wait). Na kozala na esika na yango ya kozala na 'not', tozali kopesa 'not' liboso ya infinitif to gerundium (I decided not to go, I enjoy not working).

title: Articles Advanced: Zero Article and Generic Use / Bandako ya Makasi: Bandako ya Moko mpe Bosungi na Ndakisa
bridge: Na espanyole, tokosala na bandako ya molai mpo na kosolola biso na bango ya ndakisa (bandakisa, 'los perros son fieles'). Na anglaise, na ndakisa oyo, tokosala te na bandako nione: 'Dogs are loyal'. Oyo ezali likambo mabe ya kopona mpo na bato ya espanyole: ozali koleka koloba 'The dogs are loyal' na anglaise, oyo esengi ete ozali kosolola na bango ya ndakisa. Mpe na anglaise, tokosala te na bandako na bangogo ya makela na ndakisa ('I like rice'), mpe na espanyole tokosala na bandako ('Me gusta el arroz').
rule: Na anglaise, ezali mitatu ya ndakisa ya 'bandako ya moko': 1) Mpo na kosolola na bangogo ya ndakisa na bango ya makasi to ya moko (bandakisa, 'Cats are cute', 'Water is essential'). 2) Na bangogo ya makela, mpe na bangogo ya sport mpe ya lisolo soki bazali ya ndakisa (bandakisa, 'I speak English', 'She plays tennis'). 3) Na bangogo ya makasi ya ndakisa 'school', 'hospital', 'church', 'prison' soki tokosolola na bosungi na bango (bandakisa, 'He goes to school' - kotiya na lisolo, te kotiya kaka mpo na kosala vizite). Bosembo: na bangogo ya moko ya makasi, tokosala na bandako to na bosembo, ata na bosungi (bandakisa, 'A dog is man's best friend' to 'The dog is a loyal animal'). Tokoki koloba te 'Dog is loyal' mpo na kosolola na bango nionso ya ndakisa. Mpe na anglaise, tokosala te na 'the' na bangogo ya mikili soki bazali na mibeko ya politik te (bandakisa, 'Italy', 'Spain'), kasi tokosala na 'the' na bangogo ya ndakisa 'republic', 'kingdom' to 'states' (bandakisa, 'the United States').

examples.note: Bangogo ya mpeve tokosala te na bandako na anglaise, kasi na espanyole tokosala na 'el español'.

examples.original: Football is popular in Europe.
examples.phonetic: /ˈfʊtbɔːl ɪz ˈpɒpjʊlər ɪn ˈjʊərəp/
examples.translation: Mpembe ezali ya ndakisa na Ewropa.
examples.note: Bangogo ya sport tokosala te na bandako. Na espanyole, tokosala na 'el fútbol'.

levels.label: Zero Article with Institutions and Fixed Phrases
levels.translation: Bandako ya moko na bangogo ya makasi mpe na bangogo ya ndakisa

examples.original: He goes to school by bus.
examples.phonetic: /hiː ɡəʊz tə skuːl baɪ bʌs/
examples.translation: Ye akotambola na bus mpo na koya na lisolo.
examples.note: Tokosala te na bandako soki tokosolola na 'school' mpo na lisolo. Soki azali koya mpo na kosala vizite, tokoloba 'to the school'.

examples.original: She is in hospital after the accident.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ɪz ɪn ˈhɒspɪtl ˈɑːftə ði ˈæksɪdənt/
examples.translation: Ye azali na spitali na nsuka ya akobo.
examples.note: Na anglaise ya angleterre, 'in hospital' esengi ete ozali na spitali. Na anglaise ya amerika, tokoloba 'in the hospital' mpe mpo na bato ya spitali.

examples.original: They go to church every Sunday.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɡəʊ tə tʃɜːtʃ ˈevri ˈsʌndeɪ/
examples.translation: Bango akotambola na ntalo nionso ya mingu.
examples.note: Mpo na koya na ntalo, tokosala te na bandako. Soki ozali koya mpo na kosala vizite, tokoloba 'to the church'.

examples.original: We went to bed early.
examples.phonetic: /wiː went tə bed ˈɜːli/
examples.translation: Tokola na likolo ya zonga.
examples.note: Bangogo ya ndakisa lokola 'go to bed', 'go to work', 'at home' tokosala te na bandako.

translations.ln: Bandako ya makasi: bandako ya moko mpe bosungi na ndakisa
